single_outlet_findings.finding: Only headline to frame the Khamenei encounter as a spy-thriller scene—'In Total Darkness, Wondered If It Was Really Him'—transforming a political opacity story into a narrative of physical mystery about the leader's very identity.
Only headline to link leadership inaccessibility to the Hormuz Deal timeline ('as Hormuz Deal Nears'), converting the domestic political crisis into a strategic-economic stakes story.
Only outlet to lead with Khamenei's direct threat to accept Pezeshkian's resignation—the most confrontational framing of the leader-president rift from any source in the corpus.

bottom_line: The headline layer presents a near-consensus framing of Iranian state dysfunction—an absent, inaccessible supreme leader and a president who can barely reach him—while US right-wing outlets add a sensational clandestine dimension and Iranian state media deflects entirely to Palestinian solidarity.
